item.text:
Created a complete Rust 2021 project in `/output` with the root entry [test12.rs](/output/test12.rs), library root [lib.rs](/output/lib.rs), and modular conversion/formatting code under [color/converter.rs](/output/color/converter.rs) and [color/formatting.rs](/output/color/formatting.rs). The implementation stays `std`-only and matches the C++ CLI behavior, including the `argc > 3` defaulting rule and C++ `std::cout` float formatting (`%g`-style 6 significant digits, padded scientific exponents, and signed `-0`).

It compiles with both `cargo build --release` and `rustc --edition=2021 test12.rs -o test12`. Executables are available at `/output/target/release/test12` and `/output/test12`. I verified byte-for-byte output against `/workspace/dataset/test12_executable` on the provided examples, a 125-case RGB grid, and several out-of-range inputs; all matched.
